notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Traveling Minister's ability by tapping it, causing target creature to get +1/+0 until end of turn, and you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
